title: Where does S3's Wayfinder ticket live?
body:
The sources are silent on this. AssemblyAI#12 makes S3 the resolution of "one real Wayfinder ticket of AsmAI's next map", recorded in the tracker. AssemblyAI#27 moved S1's feature, S4's fix and the proving record to talvor/asmai, but did not mention S3. It also says talvor/AssemblyAI keeps the v1 planning record, and that after v1.0.0 changes are recorded in talvor/asmai. S3 needs a registered repository whose tracker holds the map.

Rule 27 in the draft is open until you answer.
rec: A. AsmAI's next map is about the code and releases that live in talvor/asmai, and AssemblyAI#27 already moves AsmAI's later record there. B would add new planning to a repository that is meant to stay the record of v1's planning.
options: A: talvor/asmai: the next map and its Wayfinder tickets are issues there, and S3 resolves one of them
B: talvor/AssemblyAI: the next map is charted beside the v1 map

title: Accept 11 Qualification and proving?
body: Accepting applies your answer above and any annotations. I then commit the document and start the milestone documents with M0 Groundwork. If you would rather see the changes first, choose another round.
rec: A, unless your annotations change substance.
options: A: accept, with my answers and annotations applied
B: show me another round with the changes
